newsitem.title: CANADA: MPE calls for oilseed delivery in Red River Valley.
newsitem.headline: MPE calls for oilseed delivery in Red River Valley.

text.p: Red River Valley farmers were encouraged to deliver oilseeds and non-Canadian Wheat Board grains into Manitoba Pool Elevators facilities ahead of expected spring floods, an MPE official said.

"We'll be encouraging early delivery of non-Board grains and oilseeds. You can bet we'll be doing everything we can to make it easy for producers to deliver into the system," MPE spokesman Brian Phillips told Reuters.
Snowfall in the Red River watershed has been two to three times more than normal this winter, Manitoba Water Resources Branch said.
The CWB Tuesday called for more grain deliveries there.
"We're letting the farmers know where we have space available at the present time, that we will be trying to take advantage of unit trains whereever possible," Phillips added.
